overview_description.description:
Unacademy is a learning platform that provides content for major competitive examinations as well as offers short lectures in the form of videos on different subjects which can be accessed for free. It allows aspiring students to better prepare for their competitive examinations and promote self-learning.

Unacademy was originally created in 2010 via YouTube channel and was officially launched in 2015. The company is based in Bangalore, India.

about_short_description.short_description: Unacademy is an online learning platform that provides educational content such as video lectures and examinations.

product.name: Unacademy Learning Platform
product.description: An online learning platform providing live and recorded classes, structured courses, educator interaction, and exam-preparation resources across more than 200 examination goals.

product.name: Unacademy Exam Preparation Courses
product.description: Structured online courses for examinations including UPSC, IIT JEE, NEET UG, banking, SSC, CAT, CBSE, and CA, delivered through live and recorded lessons.

product.name: Unacademy Subscription
product.description: A subscription service providing access to live and recorded classes, structured courses, and doubt-clearing sessions across selected examination categories.

product.name: Unacademy Practice and Revision Resources
product.description: Online practice resources including mock tests, practice activities, lecture notes, and downloadable PDF study materials for revision and examination preparation.

product.name: Unacademy Learning App
product.description: Mobile applications for accessing Unacademy lessons, live and recorded classes, practice resources, and downloadable learning content on supported devices.
